notes: Versio is Imagine Communications' 100%-software integrated/channel-in-a-box playout platform (automation + video server + switcher + graphics + master control), delivered on an HPE ProLiant Gen10-based 1RU or 2RU rack server (VER-HW-1UG10 / VER-HW-2UG10). Physical I/O is license/board-configurable rather than fixed. Data pulled from Imagine Communications' own "Versio Channel in a Box" and "Versio Modular Playout" datasheets (both list an identical "BROADCAST I/O" / "SYSTEM SPECIFICATION" table), retrieved via the av-iq.com document CDN because imaginecommunications.com direct PDF links returned 404/403; both PDFs cite imaginecommunications.com as their canonical source in-document. Genlock/reference is carried via PTP (SMPTE ST 2059-2) over the network rather than a physical BNC black-burst input, so no analog genlock port is listed. SDI grade is listed only as "HD-SDI" (mapped to sdi-hd) except for the optional quad-link UHD I/O, which is explicitly "four-wire 3G-SDI" (sdi-3g). AC power connector type is not stated in either datasheet and is inferred from typical HPE Gen10 server PSUs — treat with low confidence specifically for that port. B&H hosts a separate litfile (lit_files/584207.pdf) referencing "2 x 12Gb/s SDI" for what appears to be a related Versio/Nexio product, but that file could not be retrieved (403) or corroborated, so higher SDI grades (6G/12G) were not included.

ports.name: SDI Out 2
ports.note: Outputs are software-configurable (program/preview/branded variants). Board options scale SDI count up to 6 in / 6 out (2RU MA500 I/O card, VER-HW-2UIO-SDI).

ports.name: Key/Fill In (optional)
ports.note: Optional external key+fill input pair for upstream keyer sources; up to 2 pairs available per datasheet.

ports.name: UHD In (optional, 4x SDI quad-link)
ports.note: Optional single UHD live input, four-wire 3G-SDI, 2SI or QSD mode; requires UHD license.

ports.name: UHD Out (optional, 4x SDI quad-link)
ports.note: Optional single UHD program output, four-wire 3G-SDI, 2SI or QSD mode; requires UHD Graphics license.

ports.name: Compressed Video (IP)
ports.note: Optional port for compressed IP in/out (MPEG-2 TS, H.264).

ports.name: Uncompressed Video (IP)
ports.note: Optional port for uncompressed SMPTE ST 2022-6 / ST 2110 video, Intel 82599 chipset. Listed as 1x 10GbE in the 'Versio Channel in a Box' datasheet; the 'Versio Modular Playout' datasheet lists 2x 25GbE for the same field on some server configs — connector inferred as SFP/SFP+, not stated explicitly.

ports.name: AC Power
ports.note: Not detailed in the datasheet; inferred from the standard redundant hot-plug power supplies on the underlying HPE ProLiant Gen10-based 1RU/2RU chassis (VER-HW-1UG10 / VER-HW-2UG10) that Versio ships on.
